_doc: What the renderer allocates at startup (openspec/changes/engine-stack, design sections 5 and 8; read by sc-core::data::RenderConfig). sokol_gfx's pools are fixed at sg_setup, which is CLAUDE.md 2's allocate up front: a pool too small fails loudly when a resource is made. The sizes are first choices for the Tern (about 37 compartments, one buffer pair each, a few programs and targets) with room for the probe's scenes; the probe reports the memory they take (design section 11, scene 8).
